report.summary: The real-board boot-loop regression is fixed in code (idempotent single display init, dashboard waits on app_display_ready, stray CMakeLists.txt.new gone, SNTP race and default-broker port corrected); remaining items are spec-behaviour warnings (single-button reset, 3-number voice vocabulary, plain-MQTT default broker, empty-payload TRV poll) that do not block the build, and a hardware re-run is still outstanding.

report.dataModel: No Matter/RainMaker model. MQTT: publish {"current_heating_setpoint": "<x.y>"} to zigbee2mqtt/<TRV> (qos1, retain 0); on connect subscribe each TRV and air-sensor topic and then publish an empty message to each; {"time": 254} to zigbee2mqtt/bridge/request/permit_join; retained status zerocode/<mac12>/status with last-will. HTTP /settings (GET/POST), /api/state, /api/set.

bootSequence: app_audio_init (generic DSP kernel, English vocabulary, AFE + WakeNet + MultiNet)

app_display_init (single display_setup task: lvgl_port_init, lvgl_port_add_disp_rgb, lvgl_port_add_touch, sets app_display_ready()) + heating_ui_init (waits for ready up to 30 s, builds cards under the LVGL lock)
app_mqtt_init (NVS config or defaults Wi-Fi 'free4all' / broker mqtt://homeassistant.gdenu.fi:1883, then STA or onboarding AP)
diagnostics_clock_init (TZ + SNTP on its own task)

notes: Double display bring-up fixed structurally (idempotent app_display_init + app_display_ready/ failed), which removes the real-board boot loop; a hardware re-run is still outstanding.
app_audio.cpp calls heating_ui_poke() plus heating_voice_print_vocabulary() (168-170, 178-180) and compiled cleanly in this tree's build.
Factory reset is a 10 s single-button hold (documented deviation from SET+MODE).
Default Wi-Fi 'free4all'/'password' and plain-MQTT default broker are compiled in when nothing is stored (owner's request).
The 'state request' publishes an empty message to each TRV state topic, which zigbee2mqtt also accepts as a command.
spec.json marks every feature 'built' while product_testing's LCD/boot-health items have not been re-run after the fix.

peripherals.driver: app_display (single setup task, lvgl_port_add_disp_rgb + add_touch, app_display_ready())
app_audio (AFE + MultiNet) on app_dsp_shim's generic dot product
app_mqtt (STA defaults, onboarding SoftAP, CA in NVS, state-request poll)

findings.description: The 10 s single-button factory reset wipes NVS (Wi-Fi, broker URI/credentials, CA, room table) on a hold that can happen by accident: the same button's short click is push-to-talk, and the countdown only starts at the 1 s mark with a banner a dimmed screen may hide. The spec's deliberate two-finger SET+MODE combination exists to make this unlikely; the firmware keeps the easier trigger and only documents it.
findings.evidence: app_logic.cpp:247-258 on_set_arm arms s_fr_timer on BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_START (COMBO_ARM_MS 1000) at :375-376; factory_reset_cb :214-221 -> heating_factory_reset (nvs_flash_erase + esp_restart). artifacts/031 notes it as a documented deviation.
findings.failureScenario: A child, or a user resting a finger on the front button while reading, holds it 10 s: settings and the four room topics are erased and the panel reboots to onboarding, with no second button confirming intent.
findings.suggestedChange: Require a second, independent confirmation for the same hold (a volume key down, or a confirming click inside the countdown), or keep the spec's SET+MODE combination.

findings.description: Spoken setpoints cover only three numbers (20, 21.5, 21-and-a-half) for every room, so the spec's own example 'set the office to 21' has no phrase and any other value is unreachable by voice.
findings.evidence: heating_voice.cpp:66-72 k_variant_tenth = {200, 215, 210}; phrase_text :96-107 builds only those three variants per room.
findings.failureScenario: A user says 'set the office to 21': no such phrase is in the model, the window ends with 'Sorry, not understood' and nothing is published.
findings.suggestedChange: Generate the phrase set over the real range if MultiNet's phrase budget allows, or document the three-number limit in the UI and the product description.

findings.description: The factory default broker is plain MQTT (mqtt://homeassistant.gdenu.fi:1883), so TRV setpoints and broker credentials travel unencrypted by default, where the previous default was TLS.
findings.evidence: app_mqtt.cpp:145-150 HEATING_DEFAULT_BROKER_URI "mqtt://homeassistant.gdenu.fi:1883"; TLS only for mqtts/ssl/:8883 (mqtt_start_client :199-203).
findings.failureScenario: A fresh panel joins 'free4all' and dials the default broker over plain 1883: anyone on the network can capture the broker password and rewrite every setpoint.
findings.suggestedChange: Default to the TLS listener now that the pinned CA is persisted and the settings page explains the ports; keep 1883 as an explicit user choice.

findings.description: On every connect the panel publishes an EMPTY message to each TRV state topic to 'ask' for state; zigbee2mqtt treats a message on a device topic as a command, and an empty payload is not a documented read request (only the air-sensor topics have harmless empty-payload semantics).
findings.evidence: heating.cpp:381-397 heating_request_states(): `static const char kPoll[] = ""; app_mqtt_publish(room->cfg.trv_topic, kPoll, 0, 0, false)` for TRV and sensor topics, called from heating_broker_ready :370.
findings.failureScenario: Broker comes up: the panel publishes a 0-byte message to zigbee2mqtt/0xa4c1383b5b3d7063; if the bridge forwards it, the TRV gets a malformed write — and in the benign case the panel still emits one spurious command-side message per room per connect.
findings.suggestedChange: Request state through zigbee2mqtt's read/configure path, or restrict the empty-payload poll to the air-sensor topics, leaving TRV state topics read-only for this product.

findings.description: spec.json now marks every feature 'built' with writer 'user' while touch, LED colours, voice recognition and phone onboarding are 'unverified' in artifacts/031 and product_testing's LCD/boot-health items were never re-run after the display fix.
findings.evidence: artifacts/spec.json:1-3 writer 'user' and features[] status 'built'; artifacts/032-product_testing.json result fail on 'Boot health' and 'LCD shows the dashboard'; artifacts/031 lists the hardware checks as unverified.
findings.failureScenario: A reader of spec.json believes the panel was demonstrated on the board; the next hardware session treats a crash or a blank panel as a regression against a 'built' baseline that no post-fix run supports.
findings.suggestedChange: Keep verified/unverified distinct until the outstanding hardware tests in hardware-tests.json have been run.
